description: Command palette with search, groups and shortcuts to run app actions.

howToUse: Use it as a search box for actions and pages of the app, opened by a shortcut such as ⌘K.
Group the `items` (Pages, Actions, Recent) and show the shortcut of each one when there is.
Run the choice in `onSelect`. Listen for the opening shortcut in your app and keep the normal navigation visible: not everybody knows the shortcut.
alternatives: Few actions about one item: Menu.
Picking a value in a form: Combobox.

keyboard.action: Closes the palette and returns focus to where it was.

props.name: open
props.description: Visible palette (controlled; the overlay has no internal state).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Close request: Esc, backdrop click or selection.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fired when any item is chosen.

props.name: search
props.description: Your own search: receives the items and the typed text, without leading or trailing spaces, and returns the items to show, in order. It is not called while the field is empty, when every item shows. Without it, an item shows when its label, description or keywords contain the text.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum palette width; keeps 560px when omitted.

examples.label: Open
examples.description: Open by default: type "análise" to see filtering + highlight.

examples.label: With ⌘K shortcut
examples.description: Real flow: ⌘K (or Ctrl+K) opens, Esc closes. Click the area and use the shortcut.

examples.label: With descriptions
Own search
examples.description: `search` replaces the built-in filter: here a word must match a keyword exactly, in any of the three languages.
